what: Trump-backed political outsider wins Colombia election, initial count shows

clean_source_blocks.text: Abelardo de la Espriella appears to have narrowly defeated his rival Iván Cepeda, who says the preliminary count is "not yet official or binding".

Presidential candidate Abelardo de la Espriella of the opposition Defenders of the Motherland movement. Rodrigo Abd/AP hide caption BOGOTA, Colombia—Right-wing populist candidate Abelardo de la Espriella has narrowly won Colombia's presidential election based on the preliminary "quick count" released by electoral authorities. With over 99% of the vote counted in the preliminary tally, de la Espriella leads with 49.7% over his left-wing opponent Iván Cepeda, who has secured 48.7%. The remaining ballots were blank votes. The razor-thin margin means no final result has been certified, and a slower, official manual count is expected over the coming days. Historically, Colombia's quick counts have closely tracked final certified results. Reacting to the result, De la Espriella posted on social media: "Today begins a new stage for our country, a stage built on the free and demo...

Right-wing candidate Abelardo de la Espriella has narrowly won Colombia's presidential election, an initial vote count shows, marking a dramatic shift in how the government will tackle the country's internal armed conflict and violence. De la Espriella, who was endorsed by Donald Trump, has pledged a military crackdown on illegal armed groups, drug trafficking and crime. He appeared to defeat left-wing Iván Cepeda, a close ally of the president, Gustavo Petro. De la Espriella said "today begins a new stage for our country, a stage built on the free and democratic will of millions of citizens who chose to believe in a great, safe, prosperous Colombia full of opportunities". With over 99% of votes counted, de la Espriella had won nearly 49.7% of the vote, while Cepeda won 48.7%, according to an initial count of the runoff election.

With over 99% of votes counted, de la Espriella had won nearly 49.7% of the vote, while Cepeda won 48.7%, according to an initial count of the runoff election. Cepeda has not conceded, saying the preliminary count was "not yet official or binding". "Once the official canvass takes place and its final result is produced, and the corresponding verifications have been carried out, we will recognize the official result that emerges from that structure." The verification process showed little difference to initial counting in the first round of voting on 31 May, Reuters news agency reported. De la Espriella, who was raised in the Caribbean coastal region, enjoyed significant regional support there. After the initial vote count came through, de la Espriella addressed a huge crowd of supporters who had gathered to celebrate in Barranquilla, a city on the coast.

payload.title: Oikeistopopulisti Abelardo de la Espriella johdossa Kolumbian presidentinvaalissa alustavan laskennan perusteella
payload.summary: Kolumbian presidentinvaalin alustava laskenta näyttää niukkaa voittoa Donald Trumpin tukemalle oikeistopopulisti Abelardo de la Espriellalle. Hänen vastaehdokkaansa Iván Cepeda ei ole tunnustanut tulosta, koska virallinen vahvistus puuttuu.
payload.content:
Kolumbian presidentinvaalin alustavan ääntenlaskennan mukaan oikeistopopulisti Abelardo de la Espriella on saamassa niukan voiton vasemmistolaisesta Iván Cepedasta. Tulos ei ole vielä lopullinen, sillä yli 99 prosentin laskennan jälkeen ero on vain noin prosenttiyksikkö ja virallinen tarkastuslaskenta on vielä tekemättä.

## Niukka ero alustavassa laskennassa

Alustavan laskennan mukaan de la Espriella on saanut noin 49,7 prosenttia äänistä ja Cepeda 48,7 prosenttia. Loput äänistä olivat tyhjiä ääniä. Kyse on presidentinvaalin toisesta kierroksesta, ja viranomaisten hitaamman, virallisen laskennan odotetaan jatkuvan tulevina päivinä.

Cepeda ei ole myöntänyt tappiotaan. Hän on sanonut, ettei alustava laskenta ole vielä virallinen eikä sitova. Cepedan mukaan lopullinen tulos hyväksytään vasta, kun virallinen tarkastus on tehty ja tarvittavat varmistukset on suoritettu.

Kolumbiassa alustavat niin sanotut pikalaskennat ovat aiemmin vastanneet yleensä varsin läheisesti lopullisia vahvistettuja tuloksia. Ensimmäisen kierroksen tarkistusprosessi 31. toukokuuta ei muuttanut alkuperäistä laskentaa merkittävästi.

## Käänne maan poliittisessa suunnassa

De la Espriella on opposition Defenders of the Motherland -liikkeen ehdokas. Hän on saanut tukea Donald Trumpilta ja luvannut koventaa otteita laittomia aseellisia ryhmiä, huumekauppaa ja rikollisuutta vastaan. Hänen voittonsa merkitsisi selvää muutosta siinä, miten Kolumbian hallinto suhtautuu maan sisäiseen aseelliseen konfliktiin ja väkivaltaan.

Cepeda on vasemmistolainen ehdokas ja presidentti Gustavo Petron läheinen liittolainen. De la Espriella puolestaan on kasvanut Karibian rannikkoalueella, josta hän sai vahvaa alueellista kannatusta. Alustavan laskennan jälkeen hän puhui kannattajilleen Barranquillassa, rannikkokaupungissa, jonne suuri joukko oli kokoontunut juhlimaan tulosta.

De la Espriella kuvasi tulosta uuden vaiheen alkuna Kolumbialle ja sanoi sen perustuvan miljoonien kansalaisten vapaaseen ja demokraattiseen tahtoon. Lopullinen poliittinen johtopäätös riippuu kuitenkin vielä virallisen laskennan vahvistuksesta.
summary_bullets: Abelardo de la Espriella johtaa Kolumbian presidentinvaalin alustavassa laskennassa 49,7 prosentin ääniosuudella.
Iván Cepeda ei ole tunnustanut tulosta, koska virallinen tarkastuslaskenta on kesken.
De la Espriella on luvannut kovempia toimia aseellisia ryhmiä, huumekauppaa ja rikollisuutta vastaan.
payload.journalist_note: Artikkeli perustuu paketissa olleisiin yhteneviin tietoihin alustavasta laskennasta, ehdokkaiden asemista ja tuloksen vahvistamattomuudesta. Lopullista vaalitulosta ei esitetä varmistettuna.

Abelardo de la Espriella appears to have narrowly defeated his rival Iván Cepeda, who says the preliminary count is "not yet official or binding".

Presidential candidate Abelardo de la Espriella of the opposition Defenders of the Motherland movement. Rodrigo Abd/AP hide caption BOGOTA, Colombia—Right-wing populist candidate Abelardo de la Espriella has narrowly won Colombia's presidential election based on the preliminary "quick count" released by electoral authorities. With over 99% of the vote counted in the preliminary tally, de la Espriella leads with 49.7% over his left-wing opponent Iván Cepeda, who has secured 48.7%. The remaining ballots were blank votes. The razor-thin margin means no final result has been certified, and a slower, official manual count is expected over the coming days. Historically, Colombia's quick counts have closely tracked final certified results. Right-wing candidate Abelardo de la Espriella has narrowly won Colombia's presidential election, an initial vote count shows, marking a dramatic shift in how the government will tackle the country's internal armed conflict and violence. De la Espriella, who was endorsed by Donald Trump, has pledged a military crackdown on illegal armed groups, drug trafficking and crime. He appeared to defeat left-wing Iván Cepeda, a close ally of the president, Gustavo Petro. De la Espriella said "today begins a new stage for our country, a stage built on the free and democratic will of millions of citizens who chose to believe in a great, safe, prosperous Colombia full of opportunities". With over 99% of votes counted, de la Espriella had won nearly 49.7% of the vote, while Cepeda won 48.7%, according to an initial count of the runoff election.

With over 99% of votes counted, de la Espriella had won nearly 49.7% of the vote, while Cepeda won 48.7%, according to an initial count of the runoff election. Cepeda has not conceded, saying the preliminary count was "not yet official or binding". "Once the official canvass takes place and its final result is produced, and the corresponding verifications have been carried out, we will recognize the official result that emerges from that structure." The verification process showed little difference to initial counting in the first round of voting on 31 May, Reuters news agency reported. De la Espriella, who was raised in the Caribbean coastal region, enjoyed significant regional support there. After the initial vote count came through, de la Espriella addressed a huge crowd of supporters who had gathered to celebrate in Barranquilla, a city on the coast.
